latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Daily Motivation.

- Delivers personalized encouragement based on your goals and recent achievements
- Provides contextual goal reminders and links daily actions to bigger objectives
- Celebrates your past wins to build confidence and maintain momentum
- Tracks progress with visual markers, streak counters, and completion trends
- Offers multiple motivation types: goal-based, quote-based, win-recall, future visualization, and accountability
- Supports a range of prompts for motivation, goal review, win recall, intention setting, and streak checking
